question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Try hard to do or achieve something
solution:
The solution is** Endeavour. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for "**Try hard to do or achieve something**" is "Endeavour".
 
• *For example : "She is **e****ndeavouring **to help the poor."*
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss some information regarding other options:
 
 
• **Endanger - **Put (someone or something) at risk or in danger**​**

 
 
• *For example : "He **endangered **everyones life by rash driving."*
 
 
 
• **Hardworking - **A person tending to work with energy and commitment.
 
 
• *For example : "She was working hard to pay hospital bills of her ill mother."*​
 
 
 
• **Indent - **Start a line of text or position (a block of text) further from the margin than the main part of the text 
 
 
• *For example : "Type a paragraph of text and indent the first time."*​
